title: Hodge (2,2)-Class Obstructions on CM Abelian Varieties — Lean 4 Formalization
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Lean 4 formalization of 200 measured Hodge (2,2)-class obstructions on CM abelian varieties of genera 3, 4, and 5. This repository is part of David Fox's Opera Numerorum ensemble.
